```{r Setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(visdat)
```

```{r Import, echo=FALSE}
hpm_dat <- readRDS("data/hpm_cleaned.rds")

sums <- sapply(hpm_dat, summary)


olo <- subset(hpm_dat, station == "302")
pot <- subset(hpm_dat, station == "301")

hpm_means <- hpm_dat |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    .by = c(year, date, station),
    mean_temp = round(mean(temp_c, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_do = round(mean(do, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_chla = round(mean(chla, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_spc = round(mean(spc, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_ph = round(mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  )  #drop NA rows 

```

##### Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)
```{r, echo=FALSE}
hpm_means |>
  filter(station == 302)|>
  ggplot(aes(month(date), mean_do)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(colour = year))
```

##### Temperature (deg-C)
```{r, echo=FALSE}
hpm_means |>
  filter(station == 302)|>
  ggplot(aes(month(date), mean_temp)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(colour = year))
```

##### Specific Conductivity
```{r, echo=FALSE}
hpm_means |>
  filter(station == 302)|>
  ggplot(aes(month(date), mean_spc)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(colour = year)) +
  ylim(c(70,140))+
  labs()
```

##### Chlorophyll-a
```{r, echo=FALSE}
hpm_means |>
  filter(station == 302)|>
  ggplot(aes(date, mean_chla)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(colour = year)) +
  ylim(c(0,3.5)) 
```
